name: alert_music_hold
description: Alert-first sequencing on a chaser map (TEST_FOREST kobold): the kobold spotting the hero pauses the track mid-song (music stays FOREST, no MUSIC_CHANGED -- pause is not a track change) while the level loads, the ALERT sting fires once pursuers start moving, then the forest track continues from the frozen position ~1 s later as the kobold approaches.
